items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: It was a kind of pop record that was being produced by a man that I had met and had been working with, an accordion player by the name of Mat Matthews.

ctx.x: What was your first experience in the recording studio in New York?
It was a kind of pop record that was being produced by a man that I had met and had been working with, an accordion player by the name of Mat Matthews. You know who I’m talking about?
